description: This file contains database migration code for adding implicit tags in the Superset project, including class definitions for Tag, TaggedObject, and AuditMixinNullable, as well as upgrade and downgrade functions for schema changes.

classes.name: AuditMixinNullable
classes.description: A mixin class extending AuditMixin with nullable timestamp and user reference fields.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: Represents a tag that can be attached to objects like queries, charts, or dashboards.

classes.name: TaggedObject
classes.description: Associates tags with objects, including object ID and type.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Declarative class for user query purposes.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Creates 'tag' and 'tagged_object' tables in the database.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Drops 'tagged_object' and 'tag' tables from the database.
